name: Extensions
location: Chrome/Edge: User Data\Default\Extensions\<extension-id>\<version>\manifest.json; Preferences JSON also lists installed extension IDs
purpose: Identifies browser extensions installed for a profile, including sideloaded/unpacked extensions not from an official store.
normal_baseline: Extension list matches the organization's approved/allow-listed set.
anomalies: Unpacked/developer-mode extension with broad host permissions (e.g. <all_urls>)
Extension ID not present in the official store, suggesting sideloading for credential theft or session hijacking
anti_forensic_notes: Removing an extension deletes its folder; the Preferences JSON's extension history or sync data may retain remnants briefly after removal.
